card.situation:
SWRMC requires two onsite ServiceNow Developer FTEs at Naval Base San Diego, CA, plus offsite advisory support, to migrate legacy systems and expand ServiceNow capabilities within the Cloud CITI environment — personnel must hold active CSA/CAD certifications, Top Secret/T5 eligibility, IAT-II, and DCWF 632 compliance on Day 1.
This notice reached the owner because Sooner Systems is SBA-eligible under the Total Small Business set-aside and NAICS 541512 matches exactly, but the solicitation deadline of 04 September 2026 has already passed (−9.7 days to close).
reasons_for: Firm is eligible for the Total Small Business set-aside and NAICS 541512 matches the solicitation exactly, clearing the threshold eligibility hurdle [profile: SBA-registered small business, NAICS 541512].
Security+ is held across the bench, satisfying the IAT-II baseline certification requirement on Day 1 without additional investment [req a9ef3e73-d2316e45-p4-0522c2b5].
Government confirmed that OEM/platform qualifications may be satisfied through a qualified ServiceNow subcontractor, leaving a teaming path open in principle [req a9ef3e73-45895b4c-p1-1e108f90].
reasons_against: The solicitation closed on 04 September 2026 and the computed days-to-close is −9.7, meaning any quote submitted now will not be considered for award [req a9ef3e73-descript-p0-b85c5d69].

No ServiceNow CSA or CAD certifications exist anywhere in the firm profile, and personnel must possess both active and non-expired on Day 1 of performance — a disqualifying gap that cannot be cured before the deadline [req a9ef3e73-d2316e45-p5-a29e304e].

All 22 cleared staff hold only Secret clearances; the solicitation requires an interim Top Secret based on a favorably adjudicated T5 investigation at the start of performance, and no T5-eligible personnel are documented [req a9ef3e73-45895b4c-p1-54c38c7f].

drafts.capability_statement:
Sooner Systems LLC (Norman, OK) is a SBA-certified small business fully eligible under this Total Small Business set-aside. Our NAICS 541512 primary code aligns exactly with this solicitation.

We provide professional IT services to federal defense and civilian agency customers. Our current portfolio includes IT help desk and desktop support for the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Tulsa District (2022–2025, $2.1M), and network administration and cybersecurity support for the FAA Mike Monroney Aeronautical Center (2021–2024, $1.65M). Both contracts were performed under NAICS 541512/541519 and demonstrate sustained delivery of IT staff augmentation services in regulated federal environments.

Our 22-person cleared workforce (Secret) holds CompTIA Security+ CE across the bench, satisfying the IAT-II baseline certification requirement stated in Section 4.1. Our team carries hands-on experience with RMF/ATO documentation, STIG compliance, vulnerability management (ACAS), and SAAR-N/DD Form 2875 processes — directly relevant to the DON cybersecurity compliance posture required at Naval Base San Diego.

We understand SWRMC requires two onsite ServiceNow Developer FTEs within the Cloud CITI environment. We are actively assessing teaming arrangements with qualified ServiceNow partners to address platform certification (CSA/CAD), DCWF 632 compliance, and OEM support-channel requirements, consistent with the government's confirmation that subcontractor teaming is permitted for these qualifications.

Sooner Systems is committed to delivering reliable, compliant IT staff augmentation to DoD customers and welcomes the opportunity to support SWRMC's ServiceNow modernization mission.
questions_for_co: Clearance level — Section 4.1 states personnel must possess an interim Top Secret based on a favorably adjudicated T5 investigation at the start of performance: will the government accept personnel who are currently Secret-cleared and have been submitted for a T5 investigation but have not yet received an interim TS determination, and if so, what is the maximum allowable gap between contract start and receipt of the interim TS? [req a9ef3e73-45895b4c-p1-54c38c7f]

OS/CE certification specificity — the solicitation requires valid, platform-specific Operating System/Computing Environment (OS/CE) certifications for both engineers: please identify the exact OS/CE certification titles or catalog numbers that are acceptable for the ServiceNow Cloud CITI environment so offerors can confirm or obtain the correct credentials before Day 1 [req a9ef3e73-d2316e45-p4-e32edba1]

Evaluation factors — the solicitation states 'The following factors shall be used to evaluate offers' but the full factor list, relative weights, and trade-off methodology are not reproduced in the available solicitation text: please confirm the complete list of evaluation factors, their order of importance, and whether price is evaluated on a lowest-price-technically-acceptable or best-value basis [req a9ef3e73-descript-p0-d6dc09fd]

System Handover Plan format — the solicitation requires delivery of a comprehensive System Handover Plan and training logs to SWRMC government leads at least 30 days prior to contract expiration: is there a government-furnished template or data item description (DID) that defines the required content, format, and page limitations for this deliverable? [req a9ef3e73-d2316e45-p5-bfec624e]

Teaming and OEM channel verification — the government confirmed that OEM/platform qualifications may be satisfied by a qualified ServiceNow subcontractor: what documentation must the prime submit at time of quotation to demonstrate the subcontractor's active OEM support channel (e.g., a letter of commitment, current partner portal screenshot, or subcontract agreement), and must the subcontractor be identified by legal name in the quote? [req a9ef3e73-45895b4c-p1-1e108f90, req a9ef3e73-d2316e45-p5-8b8ef44d]

Ten-business-day replacement clock — the solicitation requires that any personnel vacancy be filled with a certified, TS-eligible, DBIDS/CAC/SAAR-N-approved replacement reporting onsite to Naval Base San Diego within ten business days: does this clock begin on the date the contractor notifies the COR of a vacancy, the date the government accepts the replacement résumé, or another trigger event? [req a9ef3e73-d2316e45-p5-eaa5634a]
